verdict.rationale: A/B testing subject lines or content is a fair question for an email marketing platform like Loops, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions variant testing or automatic winner selection; campaigns are described only as one-time sends to a segment. Vague language about improving emails 'over time' and revenue attribution is adjacent at best and does not show A/B testing.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
